case.summary: Verdict: uncertain at probability 0.62 (kept within the p_engine±0.10 band), pattern out_of_region_use. The candidate episode is two in-person transactions on card C08623-K2 at billing region 330.0: 3530056 ($116.93, 2016-12-10 12:12) and the flagged 3530164 ($49.00, 2016-12-10 13:01), for total exposure $165.93. The decisive fraud evidence is the customer's own denial of 3530164 (family: customer, floors probability at 0.55) plus a card-history/memory signal: the immediately preceding transaction 3530056 scores cms_p 0.844 with a rare shared purchaser-email domain (me.com), and this card already carries 5 prior confirmed-fraud closed cases including CC-3327 (account_takeover) and CC-4957 (out_of_region_use), echoed by the retrieved similar cases CC-3061, CC-4326, CC-5127, CC-4005, CC-4625 and CC-4909, all confirmed_fraud out_of_region_use on the same card/region cluster. Against that, family history evidence is legitimacy-leaning: region 330.0 is actually a known region for this heavily-roaming card (42+ prior visits, 53 regions total) and the $49 amount is well inside its normal spending range, so an equally reasonable reading is that this is ordinary activity the customer simply doesn't recognize rather than true takeover. We requested customer_validation asking which of 3530056/3530164 the customer actually made; no reply arrived within 24 hours, so per R4 the recommendation is MONITOR_CARD plus DECLINE_TRANSACTION on any pending authorizations (L1 route) alongside the already-open CREATE_CASE (auto), with no block or report until a reply is received.
